faq.heading: Answers before you ask.
faq.description: Everything dermatology practices ask us before bundling add-ons. Need more detail? The full FAQ has everything.

items.q: Can I bundle add-ons with my existing website plan?
items.a: Yes. Every add-on is designed to layer onto your current DermatologyWebsiteDesign.com plan or an existing site we onboard. Bundling multiple add-ons unlocks volume pricing that's shown on your custom quote.
Every integration, form, hosting choice, and analytics setup is HIPAA-aware by default. We provide BAAs where applicable and audit PHI exposure across forms, chat, and marketing pixels.

items.q: Do I have to commit to a long contract?
items.a: No. Add-ons are month-to-month unless you choose an annual plan for a discount. You keep every asset — code, content, credentials, backups — if you leave.

items.q: How fast can you launch an add-on?
items.a: Most integrations, tracking setups, and content services launch within 3–10 business days. Larger builds like custom CRO programs or migrations follow a scoped timeline shared upfront.

items.q: Do you support sites you didn't build?
items.a: Yes. After a paid technical audit we onboard existing dermatology sites — WordPress, Webflow, custom, or headless — and layer add-ons on top.
